page: UpCloud GPU-96xCPU-960GB-4xB200 is an x86_64 architecture server virtualized via the KVM hypervisor. The system features 96 vCPUs with a shared CPU allocation model and is equipped with 960.0 GB of system memory, yielding 10.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server integrates four NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs, providing a total of 768 GB of VRAM. The configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The hardware profile represents a high-density accelerator class designed for large-scale parallel processing. The shared CPU allocation and lack of local storage are key architectural tradeoffs to consider when planning deployments. This configuration is designed for workloads such as large language model training, deep learning, and data science jobs that require massive GPU memory and parallel computing capabilities.
